art_direction: 浅玫粉底，左眼低而开、右眼高而轻眯，像在认真听。
composition_variation: Left eye lower and more open; right higher and softly hooded. Both pupils slightly left as if following an interesting explanation off-frame. Left lower boundary generous and rounded, right a smoother flatter curve. Responsive, intelligent engagement resembling attentive listening without drawing ears, eyebrows or head outline. Keep asymmetry gentle rather than a dramatic tilt.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
